mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assignment_feedbacks (assignment_id, student_id, teacher_id, comment, drawing_url) VALUES (#{assignmentId}, #{studentId}, #{teacherId}, #{comment}, #{drawingUrl})
mapper.update: UPDATE assignment_feedbacks SET comment = #{comment}, drawing_url = #{drawingUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE feedback_id = #{feedbackId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM assignment_feedbacks WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attempt_feedbacks (attempt_id, teacher_id, comment, drawing_url) VALUES (#{attemptId}, #{teacherId}, #{comment}, #{drawingUrl})
mapper.update: UPDATE attempt_feedbacks SET comment = #{comment}, drawing_url = #{drawingUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE feedback_id = #{feedbackId}
mapper.select: SELECT af.* FROM attempt_feedbacks af INNER JOIN problem_attempts pa ON af.attempt_id = pa.attempt_id INNER JOIN learning_sessions ls ON pa.session_id = ls.session_id WHERE ls.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND pa.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT pa.attempt_id AS attemptId, pa.problem_id AS problemId, p.question_text AS questionText, sc.code_name AS subject, p.level, pa.submitted_answer AS submittedAnswer, p.answer AS correctAnswer, pa.is_correct AS isCorrect, pa.time_spent_sec AS timeSpentSec, p.explanation, af.feedback_id AS feedbackId, af.comment AS feedbackComment, af.drawing_url AS feedbackDrawingUrl FROM problem_attempts pa INNER JOIN learning_sessions ls ON pa.session_id = ls.session_id INNER JOIN problems p ON pa.problem_id = p.problem_id LEFT JOIN system_codes sc ON p.subject_code_id = sc.code_id LEFT JOIN attempt_feedbacks af ON pa.attempt_id = af.attempt_id WHERE ls.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND pa.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY pa.attempted_at
